_rationale_file_info_ignore: The C++ /fileinfo handler (IndexServer::handle_fileinfo) emits only file_id, path, and symbol_count -- file_id is a scanner-assigned synthetic id masked here for consistency with the other http/*.spec.json corpus specs (browse-file, definition, ...), which document it as scanner-order dependent. path and symbol_count are deterministic for a fixed corpus + file_id and are pinned in the stable tier so this golden actually verifies something (it previously masked every field /fileinfo returns, so the golden was an empty placeholder regardless of whether the request succeeded).
